title: iOS app vanishes right after launch, and app shot captures the home screen
symptom: app launch returns ok, but the app is not visible and shot shows the home screen
cause: The app crashes right after launch (e.g. Secrets.xcconfig is missing in the worktree, causing GADInvalidInitializationException)
fix: Read crash_report and the exception line in the launch_cli.py app launch response
If absent, open the latest Runner-*.ips in ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports
See console errors with xcrun simctl launch --console-pty <UDID> <bundle>
Check that local config files (Secrets.xcconfig, etc.) were copied into the worktree
